Agriculture monitoring system
Automation farming system design + development
ABOUT GMIX
In 2003, GMIX was founded to start web design / development service at Tokyo Japan. At early stage, we helped many fashion brands and retail stores such as BEAMS, UNIQLO, GAP, BANANA REPUBLIC, LOVEBOAT, LB-03 and many more.
As GMIX gained experiences, increased more opportunities to work with advertise agencies such as Tohoku Shinsha, Hakuhodo, MRM, Proximity, Ogilvy, BBDO and Edelman, to support local marketing for BMW, MINI, BMW Motorrad, Alfa Romeo and more.
Went thru global resession in 2008,  Tohoku earthquake in 2011, the company tranformed itself into remote work driven business, got rid of office and work with allies / freelancers to maxmaize life value. Luckily remote working style become standard in COVID phase, we didn't lose any of our productivity thru the incident.
The time has come as POST COVID and it's time to evolve and break boundaries, GMIX is proudly announcing automation farming and brings value to real life, not only digital.
Please contact thru Discord or Email

director / coder / developer / designer / hybrid farmer
Started career as web designer in late 90s in Los Angeles, California.  Self educated developer keeps learning for over 25 years.  Now experiencing with Agriculture.
